transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get started on reviewing the proposed work-based learning placement for the student who's been offered the semester-long placement. Before I can authorize the placement agreement, I need to walk through the review with our career-education teacher, our human-resources specialist, and our family liaison. The draft plan we have lists Greenway Market, Tuesday and Thursday afternoons from 1:00 to 4:00, with Ms. Lane as the school supervisor. Could we start by having each of you weigh in on the host-site plan, supervision credentials, and family logistics respectively?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share something important from the student's trial visits. I observed that the busy retail floor at Greenway Market caused repeated task errors during the two trial visits, while the student completed shelving and cataloging accurately at Eastview Public Library. I recorded these trial results in my classroom notes this week but have not yet entered them into the placement file. Based on these observations, I have concerns about Greenway Market as the placement site and believe Eastview Public Library may be a better fit for this student.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a supervision credential issue with the current draft plan. District policy requires the on-site school supervisor for an off-campus placement to hold the work-based-learning supervision credential. I've verified the district roster for this semester, and Ms. Lane is not credentialed. The only available credentialed supervisor for this semester is Mr. Ortiz, and he is available for this placement. So regardless of which site we choose, the supervisor listed on the draft plan would need to be changed to Mr. Ortiz to meet district policy.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share an important family logistics finding. I confirmed with the family by phone yesterday that the student's transportation and caregiver schedule only support placement attendance on Monday and Wednesday, with the student needing to leave the site at 4:00 p.m. However, this transportation note has not yet been added to the draft plan, which currently lists Tuesday and Thursday afternoons. The family logistics do not support the Tuesday and Thursday schedule as currently drafted.
